name: @heady/sync-fabric
description: Hardened cross-device sync fabric — mandatory-auth /ws/sync WebSocket transport with device presence, session handoff (resumable context), shared context broadcast, debounced persistent user/workspace state, and event receipts. φ-capped: FIB[13] KB messages, FIB[8] msg/s, 2·φ⁷s heartbeat.
